headline: Full Face of NYX: A Makeup Artist's Honest Review
description: Prague makeup artist Nikol Pavlova tests a full face of NYX with an honest all-day wear test and a professional verdict.

name: Full Face of NYX — testing bestsellers and new launches
description: Nikol Pavlova applies a complete look using only NYX products and tests how it wears over a full day.

mainEntity.name: Do professional makeup artists really use drugstore brands like NYX?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. A working kit is a mix of price points and what matters is how a product performs, not its label. Several NYX products — the bronzer, pressed powder, mascara and long-wear liner — hold their own next to far pricier options.

mainEntity.name: What were the best NYX products in this test?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cult bronzer, the pressed powder, the brow glue, the mascara, the long-wear eyeliner, and the concealer for targeted spot coverage.

mainEntity.name: Is NYX makeup good enough for a wedding or a long event?

acceptedAnswer.text: The long-wear pieces — powder, setting spray, locking liner and brow glue — can last impressively well. For your wedding day a professional application and a trial first are still recommended.

mainEntity.name: Which NYX products should I be careful with?

acceptedAnswer.text: The plumping primer can feel tight on dry or flaky skin, and the matte eyeshadows are lovely but lower in pigment, so swatch them first.

mainEntity.name: Can I learn to create a full-face look like this myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Personalised one-on-one makeup courses cover skin prep, colour theory, application and product selection, tailored to your skin type and goals.
Nikol is an English-speaking makeup artist based in Prague, Czech Republic, and travels across the Czech Republic and Europe for weddings, shoots and events.
